title: Head and Hand
label: ch:hi-head-and-hand
canDo: I can name the head and the hand in Hindi and trace both back to the Sanskrit words they wore down from.

payoff.summary: Say सिर and the śiras it wore down from, then हाथ, then हस्त, and the shape of the change between them: the -st- cluster simplifies and the vowel lengthens.
payoff.note: HI-C13-haath now recalls सिर and its Sanskrit source as well as its own word and sound change: 3 of the chapter's 5 atoms. The two one-character recognition segments (HI-S08-letter-sa, HI-S117-letter-ca, sequence 605-606) come after the payoff in reading order, so it cannot honestly assess them.
